leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize TanStack Query in a Vue application by installing dependencies and configuring the QueryClient
Implement data fetching with useQuery to retrieve and display API data in Vue components
Configure query options to control caching, retry behavior, and stale time for API requests
Manipulate query states to handle loading, error, and success scenarios in the UI
Integrate TanStack Query with Vue's reactive system to automatically update components when data changes
Construct a data fetching pattern that separates data logic from presentation components
Apply query invalidation to refresh data when user actions require updated information
